This severe deflation in price occurs against a micro-cap market capitalization of just 113 crores, indicating a lack of institutional sponsorship or liquidity support [E3]. Furthermore, the business returns zero cash to its shareholders, as evidenced by a stagnant dividend yield of 0.00 percent [E4]. Investors are paying a price-to-book multiple of 1.35x on a book value of 58.2 against a share price of 78.6, yet they receive no income stream to compensate for the stagnation near yearly lows [E2, E4, E5]. The valuation of 15.1x earnings is entirely unsupported when the equity cannot break out from the very bottom of its annual trading band [E1, E5].
